text:
Predicates:
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x was published by y.
InLanguage(y, z) ::: y is in language z.
TranslatedFrom(y, z) ::: y was translated from z.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Press(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
Specialize(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
Premises:
Press(newVesselPress) ∧ ∀x (PublishedBy(x, newVesselPress) → Book(x)) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house and all books it publishes are published by it.
∀x (PublishedBy(x, newVesselPress) → InLanguage(x, english)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in English.
PublishedBy(neapolitanChronicles, newVesselPress) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is published by New Vessel Press.
TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
PublishedBy(palaceOfFlies, newVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies is published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
¬PublishedBy(harryPotter, newVesselPress) ::: Harry Potter was not published by New Vessel Press.
